description: Legal Metrology compliance rules applicable to clothing, garments, hosiery and textiles.

rules.title: Loose/open sale of garments and hosiery — alternative declaration regime
rules.requirement: Garments or hosiery sold loose or open at the point of sale, in a manner that allows the consumer to inspect the product before buying, are exempt from standard pre-packaged declarations PROVIDED the product carries: (i) name and address of the manufacturer/marketer/brand owner/importer, with country of origin/manufacture for imported products; (ii) consumer care e-mail ID and phone number; (iii) size in metric notation (cm or m) and/or with internationally recognizable size indicators such as S, M, L, XL, XXL, XXXL; (iv) maximum retail price of the package, inclusive of all taxes, in Indian currency. This exemption applies to finished products only. If sold via e-commerce, the same information must be displayed on the e-commerce website. A manufacturer/packer/importer may voluntarily declare this information with immediate effect regardless of the commencement date.
rules.applies_when: Applies to garments/hosiery sold loose or open for pre-purchase inspection, effective 1 January 2023 (item (iii) wording updated with effect from the 2023 amendment). Consistent with earlier (2016/2017) departmental advisory guidance on the same subject.

rules.title: Thread sold in coil to handloom weavers — exemption
rules.requirement: Any thread which is sold in coil to handloom weavers is exempt under rule 26 of the LM(PC) Rules, 2011.
rules.applies_when: Applies to thread sold in coil form specifically to handloom weavers.
